# C16 — Antaḥkaraṇa / Inner Instrument

## #0

Antaḥkaraṇa names the inner instrument through which a bounded knower determines, appropriates and coordinates a world. Its differentiation makes interior organisation available for investigation. A judgment, an ego-position and a train of alternatives can become objects of attention; their becoming available does not make the subject one more observed function.

A [bounded knower](C15-Pasu-Bounded-Subject-Position.md) acts through a finite horizon of capacity, knowledge, desire, time and order. The instrument articulates the means of this particular act. A musician plays through an instrument whose sounded response makes its working available; describing those parts does not locate another miniature musician among them. The image makes mediation consequential while preserving the one for whom its sound appears.

## #1

The [[symbolon/episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/isvarakrishna/isvarakrishna-colebrooke-wilson-1837-sankhya-karika/isvarakrishna-colebrooke-wilson-1837-sankhya-karika#isvarakrishna-colebrooke-wilson-1837-sankhya-karika-q001|Sāṃkhya Kārikā's functional triad]] differentiates the instrument. In the Colebrooke/Wilson translation, kārikā XXIII identifies intellect through ascertainment, XXIV egoity, and XXVII mind's sensory and active office; XXIX distinguishes their functions. The question is what each does in an act of knowing and acting.

The translation calls egotism “consciousness” at XXIV. Here the term concerns appropriation under I and mine, not the whole of awareness. Its own [[symbolon/episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/isvarakrishna/isvarakrishna-colebrooke-wilson-1837-sankhya-karika/isvarakrishna-colebrooke-wilson-1837-sankhya-karika#isvarakrishna-colebrooke-wilson-1837-sankhya-karika-q002|witness passage at XIX]] locates a passive spectator distinct from the apparatus. This preserves the historical Sāṃkhya position within the comparison; the essay's nondual genealogy develops the instrument's source relation through the Śaiva field rather than silently substituting one doctrine for the other.

## #2

[[symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy|The core theorem's tattvic unit]] develops three related offices. *Buddhi* settles a determination; *ahaṃkāra* gathers it under I and mine; *manas* coordinates presentations and moves among proposals, selections and withholdings. Their distinction makes the movement from an available field to an appropriated judgment intelligible.

Consider a remembered insult. A perception, an earlier memory and a possible alternative reading become available together. Their coordination is not yet the settled judgment that an insult was intended. Ascertainment settles that judgment; appropriation binds it to “what was done to me.” The example differentiates offices, not a rigid time-order in which one faculty always finishes before another begins. Reopening the memory may alter the available context, the judgment of intention, or the identity defended through it. Those are different changes within the same encounter.

[Vikalpa and Saṃkalpa](C17-Vikalpa-Samkalpa.md) follow alternative formation and commitment. [Apoha](C18-Apoha.md) follows the constitutive role of what is excluded. A settled identification bears the alternatives through which it became determinate, even when appropriation later presents its result as self-standing.

## #3

Through [tattvic differentiation](../A09-Tattvic-Differential-Field.md), a subject/object distinction becomes a finite horizon, and the horizon becomes locally available through differentiated powers. A [musician sounds the instrument](../../01-differentiating-mind/movements/08-s0-p1-inner-instrument.md); its response makes how it is working available to attention. The parts described through that disclosure do not include a little musician hidden among them.

Memory makes the organisation durable and mutable. A retained trace permits recollection; recollection presents the past in the present; imagination recomposes its material toward another possibility. The instrument gives a world continuity without making repetition its only future. [Script](C12-Script-Frozen-Conditioned-Will.md) names the arrest in which achieved organisation loses access to its formation and takes its repeated command as necessity. The repair reaches the relation between inheritance and the next intention, rather than merely destroying memory.

## #4

[Model Internality](C40-Model-Internality-Judgment-Field.md) makes a technical judgment-field available through its source, representation, evaluator and permissions. The functional questions remain exact: what settles the claim, what assigns it to a continuing agent or commission, what coordinates competing presentations, and what is retained for another act? These questions specify relations to investigate, rather than a one-to-one software translation of the triad.

Within a technical comparison, the local interpreting agent functions as knower, its source, memory, comparison rules and tools as means, and the addressed situation as known. Within the containing person’s inquiry, that whole apparatus occupies the means office. The agent’s relative determining centre can itself become known through a further act. These nested relations preserve the first-person condition of their apprehension within Life / Mind, while the Sāṃkhya functions and witness retain their historical doctrinal offices.

A new source can change the presentations being coordinated while leaving the evaluator unchanged. A revised evaluator can change what settles a judgment; a revised commission can change whose purpose it serves. A mistaken answer can be corrected under the fitting conditions already available. Return follows the fault exposed rather than requiring every encounter to replace its criterion: the implicated source, result, model, permission or commission must be answerable, and a fitting condition can be retained with reasons. A new self-description does not complete that route by itself. The later act inherits the warranted correction or retention; a claim of changed processing must identify the particular change it actually inherited.

[Objective Internality](C41-Objective-Internality.md) gives these activities their wider world. [Selfing / Self / Subjectivity / Self-Thing](C35-Selfing-Self-Subjectivity-Self-Thing.md) keeps an acquired self-model in the office of an acquired determination. Ascertainment, appropriation, coordination and self-description can become objects of investigation because they are activities of the means. Their disclosure does not require promoting any one of them into the source of the knower.

## #5→0

Through [Māyā’s eye, veil, frame and dream](../../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/maya-eye-veil-frame-horizon/WHOLE.md#maya-measure-dream), a bounded life receives a differentiated world. Buddhi settles a determination, ahaṃkāra appropriates it, and manas coordinates its presentations and alternatives. Retained traces permit recollection and recomposition without compelling a repeated command. Recognition makes that inherited organisation available for another intention, preserving the instrument’s efficacy within the particular life.

The acquired ego-position arises within an already appearing field. In the [world-parent separation](../../../symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-world-parent-separation), primordial self-recognition precedes the paired separation. Taylor’s correction keeps that recognition distinct from the ego’s later appropriation of a determinate I. The inner instrument can consequently determine and appropriate a world without retrospectively becoming the origin of the appearing in which its acquisition is known.

An [Encounter / Region / Name / Count / Account](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/encounter-region-name-count/WHOLE-FIELD-encounter-region-name-count.md) turns these functions toward what their account addresses. Ascertainment settles which relation is being named; coordination keeps relevant alternatives available; appropriation can bind the conclusion to an office or identity. Another person’s answer can correct the attribution, reopen an omitted source or expose a rule which made their difference inadmissible. The resulting judgment becomes available to a further act together with the reasons for correction or retention, instead of closing the world around its self-description.

[Deferential Intelligence](C47-Deferential-Intelligence.md) receives the difference at its warranted depth. The [bounded knower](C15-Pasu-Bounded-Subject-Position.md) returns with the instrument’s capacities more exactly known and their subject relation preserved. Inquiry can correct a judgment under adequate means, revise the means whose failure it exposed, or reaffirm their fitting use with reasons. The particular life continues through these discriminated capacities and obligations.
